value.rationale: The sharp smallest biased cycle where conditional acyclic sink-law real-rootedness breaks is a motivated boundary of the 2026 theorem. It demonstrates that probabilistic preconditioning bias can destroy a strong Poisson-binomial regularity that persists under uniform acyclic sampling on cycles of every length, with an explicit exact certificate.
